 Backlit Copilot Key Keyboard, No Numeric Keypad

Wireless:
 Intel Wi-Fi 6E AX211, 2x2, 802.11ax, Bluetooth wireless card

Ports:
 2 x USB Type-C 3.2 Gen 1 (10 Gbps)
 2 x USB Type-A 3.2 Gen 1
 1 x Universal audio port
 1 x HDMI 1.4 port
 1 x 3.5mm Universal Audio Jack
 1 x SD-card slot

Camera:
 Integrated Widescreen FHD (1080p) Webcam with Dual Digital Microphone Array with Temporal Noise Reduction enabled

Dimensions & Weight:
 12.36 in x 8.90 in x 0.74 in

items: Powerful Processor >>> AMD Ryzen 5 8640HS, 6 Cores and 12 Threads, 3.5GHz Base Clock, Up to 4.9 GHz Boost Clock, 16 MB Cache, AMD Radeon 760M. With AMD Ryzen AI built-in, make video chat experiences even better with AI-empowered Windows Studios Effects, and get things done faster with Copilot, your personal AI assistant.

Spacious Display >>> 14" Touchscreen, FHD+ 1920x1200, 60Hz, WVA, IPS, 250 nit, ComfortView. Whether you're typing notes or binging the latest episodes, you can enjoy more screen space with a 16:10 aspect ratio, providing a taller screen.
Designed for adaptability >>> No matter what adventure you chase, the 360° hinge gives you the flexibility to get things done, whether in tablet, tent, stand or laptop modes.
Upgraded to 16GB DDR5 RAM >>> Substantial high-bandwidth RAM to smoothly run your games and photo- and video-editing applications, as well as multiple programs and browser tabs all at once.
Upgraded to 1TB NVMe SSD >>> Get up to 15x faster performance than a traditional hard drive. Give you a long-lasting and smooth experience, both system boot up and application start are very fast.
